docs.purpose: Provides the searchable, sortable, paginated list of building contractors shown on the public builders directory page.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `entities` and `entity_projects` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `web_builders_list`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: No SPEC LINK header. SELECT * FROM entities restricted to rows with a Builder role via a subquery on entity_projects. The ALLOWED_SORT whitelist guards ORDER BY against injection but does not restrict the response fields, so the projection is the whole row. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: DISCLOSURE FINDING (PUBLIC, unauthenticated — src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:72): `SELECT * FROM entities` at :36 exposes EVERY entities column to any anonymous caller, including the contact/PII-adjacent fields primary_phone, primary_email, website, linkedin_url, and the enrichment fields google_place_id, google_rating, google_review_count, is_wsib_registered, photo_url, name_normalized (docs/specs/00-architecture/01_database_schema.md:487-505). There is no column allowlist and no field redaction anywhere in the file. A future column added to `entities` is disclosed automatically — flagged per instruction: SELECT * usage. DEFECT (unvalidated numeric input): `?limit=abc` makes parseInt NaN, Math.min(NaN,100) is NaN, and NaN is passed as the LIMIT bind param at :39 -> pg error -> 500 at :61; `?limit=0` yields LIMIT 0 and total_pages: Infinity at :54 (JSON.stringify renders Infinity as null); `?offset=-1` is passed straight through to OFFSET. No NaN/lower-bound guard exists (contrast the events route's Number.isFinite clamp at src/app/api/admin/users/[uid]/subscription/events/route.ts:52-54). SQL INTERPOLATION: `ORDER BY ${sort} ${sortOrder}` at :37 interpolates into SQL, but `sort` is allowlist-constrained at :14-15 and `sortOrder` is a strict two-valued ternary at :16, so it is not injectable as written — it is nonetheless an interpolation a reviewer must re-check on any edit to ALLOWED_SORT. The subquery at :24 is a real table (entity_projects), not an alias. No SPEC LINK header — the file starts at the import at :1. No logError context beyond {handler:'GET'} at :58. CENSUS CHECK: census_reads [entities, entity_projects] confirmed exactly; census_writes [] confirmed (the file contains no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE). | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control header, no revalidate/dynamic export in the file | Pagination: LIMIT $n OFFSET $n+1 at :38-39. limit = Math.min(parseInt(raw||'20'),100) at :10 — upper-clamped only; offset = parseInt(raw||'0') at :11 — unclamped. total from COUNT(*) at :42-46; page = floor(offset/limit)+1 and total_pages = ceil(total/limit) at :52-54. | Other guards / classification: NO GUARD AT ALL. The path is classified PUBLIC by the prefix '/api/builders' in PUBLIC_PREFIXES at src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:72, matched by startsWith at src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:170 — so an unauthenticated caller reaches the handler. | Locking tests: src/tests/api.infra.test.ts.
